caption:
Want round, lifted glutes? Stop chasing heavy weights — master your technique 👇

✅ Upper back on the bench, just below your shoulder blades
✅ Feet hip-width or slightly wider, toes slightly out
✅ Chin tucked, core engaged — drive through your feet
✅ Straight line from shoulders to knees at the top
✅ Squeeze 1–2 seconds, slightly tuck your pelvis
✅ Lower slowly, back neutral

3–4 sets of 8–12 reps. Technique first — results will follow.
Save this for your next glute workout 🍑 Comment "START" 💪

#hipthrust #glutebridge #glutesworkout #strengthtrainingforwomen #personaltrainersingapore
